thesis: Current networking makes people perform relevance publicly and manually cross attention boundaries.
role: Explain how agents can reuse channels and transform brokerage.

ideas.statement: Profiles privilege standardized public presentation; private intention should govern cross-source search instead.
Permissioned signed requests can qualify relevance before the inbox while remaining readable through ordinary email for nonparticipants.
Brokers compress contextual trust and may become verifiers or exception handlers rather than disappear.
